concept_definitions.label: Ceramic assemblage
concept_definitions.definition: A documented group of archaeological ceramic material treated as an analytical unit.
concept_definitions.boundaries: Decorative discussion without archaeological context is outside the core evidence role.

concept_definitions.label: Petrographic characterization
concept_definitions.definition: Microscopic mineralogical and fabric analysis used to characterize ceramic material.
concept_definitions.boundaries: Other compositional techniques may be contextual unless the protocol is amended.

concept_definitions.label: Exchange-network interpretation
concept_definitions.definition: An inference about movement, distribution, or interaction grounded in material provenance evidence.
concept_definitions.boundaries: Trade claims without a documented material-evidence link are not core evidence.

include: Examines relevant archaeological ceramic material or a method directly applicable to it

exclude: Discusses ceramic objects without relevant analytical or exchange interpretation
Has no identifiable archaeological context or transferable method contribution
